name: Ibiden Co.,Ltd.
summary: Ibiden Co.,Ltd. provides electronics in Japan, the rest of Asia, North America, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Electronics, Ceramics, and Others segments. The company offers plastic packaging; printed circuit boards; and integrated circuit package substrates for use as MPUs for PCs and data centers, as well as GPUs for AI and vehicles.
